data.body:
[P2] Preserve the exact Java string in cache identity

`String.getBytes(UTF_8)` silently replaces unpaired surrogates, so distinct serialized strings containing lone U+D800 and U+D801 code units produce the same digest. With otherwise identical cache-key fields, the second call can return the first cached value without invoking a custom codec that distinguishes those strings. Hash the UTF-16 code units injectively, include the original string in key equality, or reject malformed input with a reporting encoder; add a custom-SerDes regression for this collision.
